    Profile

    Zeldris is the leader of the Ten Commandments, an elite task force under the direct command of the Demon King, brought here from the Demon Realm in another world. Bestowed the Commandment of Piety, he can bend the will of those who have turned their backs to him. Zeldris plots the conquest of Britannia with his sword, power, and command.
